verdict.rationale: Crossmint is documented only as a hosted API platform (wallets, payments, agent cards and checkouts). Self-hosting is a fair question for infrastructure of this kind, but nothing in the evidence describes a self-hosted, on-prem or open-source deployment of the core product. Non-custodial wallets and switching providers without migrations are related features, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
